message:
Phase 2 + Phase 3: KB evolution and formal isomorphism detection

Phase 2 (experience feedback loop):
- Experience writer logs ExecutionRecords with structural features
- Failure-weighted evaluator (9% -> 22% keep rate on contrast groups)
- LLM-based condition writer replaces template text with semantic descriptions
- Tier-aware integrator: 36 tentative conditions applied to KB, 18/27 strategies affected
- OOD leave-one-domain-out validation: KB evolution helps practical domains
  (+2.9pp business, +7.7pp daily_life hard) but hurts formal domains (-6.4 math)
- Zero-shot KB eval jumped pre=0% -> v2=6.8% on held-out test set

Phase 3 (formalization layer):
- Markov kernel builder (108 states x 16 actions, LLM-classified)
- Distance metrics: Frobenius, spectral, Fisher-Rao, KL (Perrone 2024 asymmetry)
- Blackwell partial order via scipy linprog
- Strategy Execution Graph + graph edit distance (networkx)
- Data-driven threshold calibration
- Discovered 94 structural relations in 27 strategies (vs 0 in human annotation);
  formally refutes literature-expected pairs (S01-S15, S03-S16) via SEG evidence

Infrastructure:
- GPU migration: RE-SAC training 50K episodes in ~8min on RTX 4060
- Precomputed feature + embedding cache (sentence-transformer once, reuse forever)
- Domain-partitioned base_env for OOD validation

v15/v16: case-based reasoning + audit — v16 beats Self-Discover +22pp

New overall champion on 100-problem benchmark (3-flash gen + judge):
  - v16 vs baseline_long:      86-14 (+72pp)
  - v16 vs ours_27:            61-39 (+22pp) ← first to beat Self-Discover
  - v16 vs v13_reflect:        61-38-1 (+23pp) ← first to beat prior champion
  - v16 vs v14_hybrid:         60-40 (+20pp)
  - v16 vs v15_exemplar:       67-33 (+34pp)

## Architecture (v16)

Domain router:
  math/science -> v12c hygiene (1-pass bare prompt + self-check)
  others       -> 2-turn cases+reflect

2-turn path:
  Turn 1 (EXECUTE_V15): draft with
    - Stage-1 priors
    - 2 wisdoms × (3 pre-mined cross-domain exemplars + 1 runtime same-domain exemplar)
    - problem
  Turn 2 (REFLECT_PROMPT): audit + revise
    - draft + priors + wisdom-brief (no repeat of cases to save context)
    - "audit: did each prior/wisdom shape draft, or just get cited? integrate 1-2 biggest misses"

## Validation of user's "civil law without precedents" hypothesis

User observed: giving wisdom text alone is like legal statutes without case
precedents — too ambiguous. Validated empirically:
  v15 (cases only): loses head-to-head to v13_reflect (39-61)
  v13_reflect (reflect only): ties ours_27 (50-50)
  v16 (cases + reflect): wins everything including ours_27

Each layer contributes independent value; combination unlocks new tier.

## Mining strategy

Static prep (build_diverse_exemplars_v15.py, GPT-5.4, ~23 min one-time):
  For each wisdom, pick 3 maximally-DIVERSE (cross-domain) problems from
  sample_100 that illustrate the principle. 75/75 achieved 3-domain spread.

Runtime same-domain retrieval: embedding cosine sim within same domain as P.
  Provides "domain-bridging" case on top of cross-domain diversity.

## Files

phase one/scripts/validation/
  - phase2_v15_exemplar_framework.py: 1-turn cases variant
  - phase2_v16_cases_reflect.py:      2-turn cases+reflect (champion)
  - build_diverse_exemplars_v15.py:   offline exemplar mining
  - build_v14_hybrid.py:              earlier hybrid (v13-reflect + ours_27 per domain)
  - phase2_baseline_long.py:          budget-matched baseline
  - build_holdout_50.py:              held-out seed=7 50-problem set

phase two/analysis/cache/
  - wisdom_diverse_exemplars.json:   75 wisdoms × 3 cross-domain exemplars
  - phase2_v14/v15/v16_*_answers.json, _drafts.json, _structures.json
  - judgments/ for all v14-v16 pair comparisons

## Domain breakdown (v16 vs ours_27)

  daily_life:  80% (v16 crushes soft)
  business:    80%
  engineering: 60%
  sw_eng:      60%
  science:     53% (tie-ish)
  mathematics: 33% (Self-Discover structure still strongest)

Math remains the floor — case-based reasoning doesn't help computation.

## Remaining for validation

  - Held-out 50 (seed=7): does v16 margin hold on unseen problems?
  - Cross-judge with GPT-5.4: rules out judge position bias (we saw non-transitivity)
  - Cross-generator (Opus/GPT-5.4): does architecture transfer upmarket?
  - n=300 scale: tighter stat significance

See v16_final_results.md for full analysis (stays on local-docs).
